NSF Funding Visualization Assignment

Tyler Sledz

2026-03-15

Load R Packages

library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ggrepel)
library(readxl)
library(gridExtra)

Data Preparation

Read the data:

data_all <- read_xlsx("NSF_Funding_by_Year.xlsx")

Peer institutions:

peer_institutions <- c(
  "Colorado State University",
  "Iowa State University",
  "Kansas State University",
  "Michigan State University",
  "North Carolina State University",
  "Oklahoma State University",
  "Oregon State University",
  "Purdue University",
  "University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign",
  "Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University",
  "Washington State University"
)

Subset for bar, scatter, and bubble plots (Year 2012):

data_2012 <- data_all %>%
  filter(AwardYear == 2012) %>%
  filter(Organization %in% peer_institutions)

Subset for time series (all years):

data_time <- data_all %>%
  filter(Organization %in% peer_institutions)

Abbreviate institution names:

For the 2012 subset:

data_2012 <- data_2012 %>%
  mutate(Abbr = recode(Organization,
    "Colorado State University"                           = "CSU",
    "Iowa State University"                               = "ISU",
    "Kansas State University"                             = "KSU",
    "Michigan State University"                           = "MSU",
    "North Carolina State University"                     = "NCSU",
    "Oklahoma State University"                           = "OSU",
    "Oregon State University"                             = "OregSU",
    "Purdue University"                                   = "PU",
    "University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign"          = "UIUC",
    "Virginia Polytechnic Institute and State University" = "VT",
    "Washington State University"                         = "WSU"
  ))
levels(data_2012$Abbr)
##  [1] "CSU"    "ISU"    "KSU"    "MSU"    "NCSU"   "OSU"    "OregSU" "PU"    
##  [9] "UIUC"   "VT"     "WSU"

For the time series subset:

levels(data_time$Organization) <- c(
  "CSU", "ISU", "KSU", "MSU", "NCSU",
  "OSU", "OregSU", "PU", "UIUC", "VT", "WSU"
)
levels(data_time$Organization)
##  [1] "CSU"    "ISU"    "KSU"    "MSU"    "NCSU"   "OSU"    "OregSU" "PU"    
##  [9] "UIUC"   "VT"     "WSU"

Highlight CSU:

data_2012 <- data_2012 %>%
  mutate(Highlight = ifelse(Abbr == "CSU", "CSU", "Peers"))

data_time <- data_time %>%
  mutate(Highlight = ifelse(Organization == "CSU", "CSU", "Peers"))

Aggregate 2012 data for plotting:

data_2012_summary <- data_2012 %>%
  group_by(Abbr, Highlight) %>%
  summarise(TotalAmount = sum(AWARD_SUM, na.rm = TRUE),
            TotalCount  = sum(AWARD_COUNT, na.rm = TRUE))
data_2012_summary

Visualizations

Visualization 1 — Bar Chart

ggplot(data_2012_summary, aes(x = TotalAmount/1000000,
                               y = reorder(Abbr, TotalAmount),
                               fill = Highlight)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(TotalAmount/1000000, 1)),
            hjust = -0.2, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("CSU" = "darkblue", "Peers" = "darkgray"),
                    guide = NULL) +
  labs(title    = "NSF Award Amount by Institution (2012)",
       subtitle = "Colorado State University vs. Peer Institutions",
       x        = "Total Award Amount ($ millions)",
       y        = NULL,
       caption  = "Source: NSF Funding by Year dataset")

Visualization 2 — Scatter Plot

ggplot(data_2012_summary, aes(x = TotalCount,
                               y = TotalAmount/1000000,
                               color = Highlight)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Abbr), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CSU" = "darkblue", "Peers" = "darkgray"),
                     guide = NULL) +
  labs(title    = "NSF Award Amount vs. Award Count (2012)",
       subtitle = "Colorado State University vs. Peer Institutions",
       x        = "Number of Awards",
       y        = "Total Award Amount ($ millions)",
       caption  = "Source: NSF Funding by Year dataset")

Visualization 3 — Bubble Plot

ggplot(data_2012_summary, aes(x     = TotalCount,
                               y     = TotalAmount/1000000,
                               size  = TotalAmount,
                               color = Highlight)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Award Amount ($M)",
                        labels = function(x) round(x/1000000, 0)) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = Abbr), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CSU" = "darkblue", "Peers" = "darkgray"),
                     guide = NULL) +
  labs(title    = "NSF Award Amount, Count, and Relative Size (2012)",
       subtitle = "Colorado State University vs. Peer Institutions\nBubble size is total award amount",
       x        = "Number of Awards",
       y        = "Total Award Amount ($ millions)",
       caption  = "Source: NSF Funding by Year dataset") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

Time Series Visualizations (All Years)

Visualization 4 — Single Time Series

ggplot(data_time_summary, aes(x = AwardYear,
                               y = TotalAmount/1000000,
                               group = Organization,
                               color = Highlight)) +
  geom_line() +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Total Award Amount ($ millions)") +
  ggtitle("NSF Award Amount Over Time (2001-2012)",
          subtitle = "Colorado State University vs. Peer Institutions") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CSU" = "darkblue", "Peers" = "darkgray"),
                     guide = NULL)

Visualization 5 — Small Multiples Time Series

ggplot(data_time_summary, aes(x = AwardYear,
                               y = TotalAmount/1000000,
                               group = Organization,
                               color = Highlight)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~ Organization) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Total Award Amount ($ millions)") +
  ggtitle("NSF Award Amount Over Time — Small Multiples (2001-2012)",
          subtitle = "Colorado State University vs. Peer Institutions") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("CSU" = "darkblue", "Peers" = "darkgray"),
                     guide = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        legend.position = "none")
